meta.title: Half Moon Eclipse
meta.description: What degree of lunar eclipse can be seen by the naked eye? Savor the hidden shadow through the lens.

units.rawText: The highest priority...
units.displayText: The highest priority...

spans.text: The highest priority...

units.rawText: You mean that we need to retrieve Hubble's Entropic Core, yes?
units.displayText: You mean that we need to retrieve Hubble's Entropic Core, yes?

spans.text: You mean that we need to retrieve Hubble's Entropic Core, yes?

units.rawText: Correct. Acquiring her Core will allow us to grasp the situation fastest, both with regards to Hubble and this Starsphere.
units.displayText: Correct. Acquiring her Core will allow us to grasp the situation fastest, both with regards to Hubble and this Starsphere.

spans.text: Correct. Acquiring her Core will allow us to grasp the situation fastest, both with regards to Hubble and this Starsphere.

units.rawText: Far more efficient than trekking through this place part by part. Can you manage it?
units.displayText: Far more efficient than trekking through this place part by part. Can you manage it?

spans.text: Far more efficient than trekking through this place part by part. Can you manage it?

units.rawText: I'm willing to go through with it, but... what do you think, Professor?
units.displayText: I'm willing to go through with it, but... what do you think, Professor?

spans.text: I'm willing to go through with it, but... what do you think, Professor?

units.rawText: So long as Hubble is here, I don't believe it will be difficult to locate the Core.
units.displayText: So long as Hubble is here, I don't believe it will be difficult to locate the Core.

spans.text: So long as Hubble is here, I don't believe it will be difficult to locate the Core.

units.rawText: Do you remember? Greater Entropics respond to the Cores of other Entropics, and can even identify their origin.
units.displayText: Do you remember? Greater Entropics respond to the Cores of other Entropics, and can even identify their origin.

spans.text: Do you remember? Greater Entropics respond to the Cores of other Entropics, and can even identify their origin.

units.rawText: Ah, with Lind... I heard.
units.displayText: Ah, with Lind... I heard.

spans.text: Ah, with Lind... I heard.

units.rawText: Yes. So Hubble may be able to unearth where her Core is, or at least have some way to sense it.
units.displayText: Yes. So Hubble may be able to unearth where her Core is, or at least have some way to sense it.

spans.text: Yes. So Hubble may be able to unearth where her Core is, or at least have some way to sense it.

units.rawText: I... myself?
units.displayText: I... myself?

spans.text: I... myself?

units.rawText: Hubble, you might not mind too much yourself... but could I ask you to feel out where your "core" is?
units.displayText: Hubble, you might not mind too much yourself... but could I ask you to feel out where your "core" is?

spans.text: Hubble, you might not mind too much yourself... but could I ask you to feel out where your "core" is?

units.rawText: Or rather, the entire Starsphere's Core.
units.displayText: Or rather, the entire Starsphere's Core.

spans.text: Or rather, the entire Starsphere's Core.

units.rawText: Hehehe... you really do know quite a lot, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehehe... you really do know quite a lot, Professor.

spans.text: Hehehe... you really do know quite a lot, Professor.

units.rawText: It is but merely conjecture.
units.displayText: It is but merely conjecture.

spans.text: It is but merely conjecture.

units.rawText: The Heat Death Entropics that attacked Jiutian had control in a radius over a variety of celestial bodies, and their control appears to be target-oriented. But you... are different.
units.displayText: The Heat Death Entropics that attacked Jiutian had control in a radius over a variety of celestial bodies, and their control appears to be target-oriented. But you... are different.

spans.text: The Heat Death Entropics that attacked Jiutian had control in a radius over a variety of celestial bodies, and their control appears to be target-oriented. But you... are different.

units.rawText: I haven't seen you manipulate the bodies yourself yet, but in this Starsphere, the distribution of bodies has completely diverged from Jiutian's basic laws. Combining that with your method of locomotion, your control is "complete", no?
units.displayText: I haven't seen you manipulate the bodies yourself yet, but in this Starsphere, the distribution of bodies has completely diverged from Jiutian's basic laws. Combining that with your method of locomotion, your control is "complete", no?

spans.text: I haven't seen you manipulate the bodies yourself yet, but in this Starsphere, the distribution of bodies has completely diverged from Jiutian's basic laws. Combining that with your method of locomotion, your control is "complete", no?

units.rawText: I would think that this entire Starsphere is more or less completely within your range of cognizance.
units.displayText: I would think that this entire Starsphere is more or less completely within your range of cognizance.

spans.text: I would think that this entire Starsphere is more or less completely within your range of cognizance.

units.rawText: As expected of the Professor—what a pleasant surprise.
units.displayText: As expected of the Professor—what a pleasant surprise.

spans.text: As expected of the Professor—what a pleasant surprise.

units.rawText: My subconscious has been telling me that you possess great might... but that is not quite what I see.
units.displayText: My subconscious has been telling me that you possess great might... but that is not quite what I see.

spans.text: My subconscious has been telling me that you possess great might... but that is not quite what I see.

units.rawText: So, Professor, I'm very curious about you. Where exactly does this star shine from? I think I can now glimpse inwards a little.
units.displayText: So, Professor, I'm very curious about you. Where exactly does this star shine from? I think I can now glimpse inwards a little.

spans.text: So, Professor, I'm very curious about you. Where exactly does this star shine from? I think I can now glimpse inwards a little.

units.rawText: Well, am I right or not?
units.displayText: Well, am I right or not?

spans.text: Well, am I right or not?

units.rawText: Hehe... haven't I already told you all about it, Professor? This is my dream. Wherever I am, it shall also be.
units.displayText: Hehe... haven't I already told you all about it, Professor? This is my dream. Wherever I am, it shall also be.

spans.text: Hehe... haven't I already told you all about it, Professor? This is my dream. Wherever I am, it shall also be.

units.rawText: But tracking down the "Core" you speak of may not be so simple.
units.displayText: But tracking down the "Core" you speak of may not be so simple.

spans.text: But tracking down the "Core" you speak of may not be so simple.

units.rawText: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...
units.displayText: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...

spans.text: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...

units.rawText: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.
units.displayText: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.

spans.text: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.

units.rawText: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.
units.displayText: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.

spans.text: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.

units.rawText: That makes it troublesome... though I never expected this whole business to go smoothly.
units.displayText: That makes it troublesome... though I never expected this whole business to go smoothly.

spans.text: That makes it troublesome... though I never expected this whole business to go smoothly.

units.rawText: There's a long road ahead... if not even Hubble herself can get ahold of it, that angle of approach becomes less viable.
units.displayText: There's a long road ahead... if not even Hubble herself can get ahold of it, that angle of approach becomes less viable.

spans.text: There's a long road ahead... if not even Hubble herself can get ahold of it, that angle of approach becomes less viable.

units.rawText: But I suppose we should at least give it a shot. Hubble, could you provide its coordinates?
units.displayText: But I suppose we should at least give it a shot. Hubble, could you provide its coordinates?

spans.text: But I suppose we should at least give it a shot. Hubble, could you provide its coordinates?

units.rawText: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.
units.displayText: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

spans.text: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

units.rawText: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.
units.displayText: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.

spans.text: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.

units.rawText: ...Hubble's right. Even within the reach of the spaceship's basic sensory systems, we can observe celestial bodies moving in ways that do not follow conventional astronomy...
units.displayText: ...Hubble's right. Even within the reach of the spaceship's basic sensory systems, we can observe celestial bodies moving in ways that do not follow conventional astronomy...

spans.text: ...Hubble's right. Even within the reach of the spaceship's basic sensory systems, we can observe celestial bodies moving in ways that do not follow conventional astronomy...

units.rawText: Forcibly chasing after something outside of our control is hardly likely to yield results. Crap...
units.displayText: Forcibly chasing after something outside of our control is hardly likely to yield results. Crap...

spans.text: Forcibly chasing after something outside of our control is hardly likely to yield results. Crap...

units.rawText: At least we've made it into the Starsphere. Antonina, don't be so hasty. Let me think.
units.displayText: At least we've made it into the Starsphere. Antonina, don't be so hasty. Let me think.

spans.text: At least we've made it into the Starsphere. Antonina, don't be so hasty. Let me think.

units.rawText: I'm more or less a layman, but... since there's the express route of chasing down the Entropic Core, chances are that there's an original "dumb way".
units.displayText: I'm more or less a layman, but... since there's the express route of chasing down the Entropic Core, chances are that there's an original "dumb way".

spans.text: I'm more or less a layman, but... since there's the express route of chasing down the Entropic Core, chances are that there's an original "dumb way".

units.rawText: Do you recall what our original plan was upon returning to Jiutian?
units.displayText: Do you recall what our original plan was upon returning to Jiutian?

spans.text: Do you recall what our original plan was upon returning to Jiutian?

units.rawText: Collect what Hubble data fragments might exist, and... explore the Starsphere, retrieving... lost Agents?
units.displayText: Collect what Hubble data fragments might exist, and... explore the Starsphere, retrieving... lost Agents?

spans.text: Collect what Hubble data fragments might exist, and... explore the Starsphere, retrieving... lost Agents?

units.rawText: ...You mean we just proceed as originally planned?
units.displayText: ...You mean we just proceed as originally planned?

spans.text: ...You mean we just proceed as originally planned?

units.rawText: Finding Hubble is a pleasant surprise, but we do not need to place all our hopes on her again.
units.displayText: Finding Hubble is a pleasant surprise, but we do not need to place all our hopes on her again.

spans.text: Finding Hubble is a pleasant surprise, but we do not need to place all our hopes on her again.

units.rawText: What do we have to lose from treating it as a new exploratory venture? Our current progress is no worse than our prior projections.
units.displayText: What do we have to lose from treating it as a new exploratory venture? Our current progress is no worse than our prior projections.

spans.text: What do we have to lose from treating it as a new exploratory venture? Our current progress is no worse than our prior projections.

units.rawText: It's okay to relax a little, Antonina. Hubble's back at our side.
units.displayText: It's okay to relax a little, Antonina. Hubble's back at our side.

spans.text: It's okay to relax a little, Antonina. Hubble's back at our side.

units.rawText: Fine. In such times we can only use the "dumb option"—first, utilize the spaceship's onboard analysis functions and explore this Starsphere properly.
units.displayText: Fine. In such times we can only use the "dumb option"—first, utilize the spaceship's onboard analysis functions and explore this Starsphere properly.

spans.text: Fine. In such times we can only use the "dumb option"—first, utilize the spaceship's onboard analysis functions and explore this Starsphere properly.

units.rawText: Xuannu will be finished with her business soon, and her Administrator Permissions can help us expand our search radius.
units.displayText: Xuannu will be finished with her business soon, and her Administrator Permissions can help us expand our search radius.

spans.text: Xuannu will be finished with her business soon, and her Administrator Permissions can help us expand our search radius.

units.rawText: Seeing as Hubble still has other data missing, we'd better have a good look for her memories in space here.
units.displayText: Seeing as Hubble still has other data missing, we'd better have a good look for her memories in space here.

spans.text: Seeing as Hubble still has other data missing, we'd better have a good look for her memories in space here.

units.rawText: About that, I think we can ask Hubble...
units.displayText: About that, I think we can ask Hubble...

spans.text: About that, I think we can ask Hubble...

units.rawText: ...Hubble?
units.displayText: ...Hubble?

spans.text: ...Hubble?

units.rawText: I turn around intending to enquire Hubble's opinion, only to find her leaning into her seat's handrests, idle.
units.displayText: I turn around intending to enquire Hubble's opinion, only to find her leaning into her seat's handrests, idle.

spans.text: I turn around intending to enquire Hubble's opinion, only to find her leaning into her seat's handrests, idle.

units.rawText: No, rather than idling, she is more... dozing off.
units.displayText: No, rather than idling, she is more... dozing off.

spans.text: No, rather than idling, she is more... dozing off.

units.rawText: <size=28>Shh... she fell asleep.</size>
units.displayText: Shh... she fell asleep.

spans.text: Shh... she fell asleep.

units.rawText: <size=28>Just then, while you were talking, she suddenly got sleepy... just like before.</size>
units.displayText: Just then, while you were talking, she suddenly got sleepy... just like before.

spans.text: Just then, while you were talking, she suddenly got sleepy... just like before.

units.rawText: This sight is a familiar one.
units.displayText: This sight is a familiar one.

spans.text: This sight is a familiar one.

units.rawText: Hubble always tended to doze off during the somewhat dull operational meetings, and with how easily she feels boredom in her current state—it follows that she would simply fall asleep, with little regard for anything else.
units.displayText: Hubble always tended to doze off during the somewhat dull operational meetings, and with how easily she feels boredom in her current state—it follows that she would simply fall asleep, with little regard for anything else.

spans.text: Hubble always tended to doze off during the somewhat dull operational meetings, and with how easily she feels boredom in her current state—it follows that she would simply fall asleep, with little regard for anything else.

units.rawText: Observing her peaceful sleeping countenance, I cannot help but lower my voice.
units.displayText: Observing her peaceful sleeping countenance, I cannot help but lower my voice.

spans.text: Observing her peaceful sleeping countenance, I cannot help but lower my voice.

units.rawText: Should we give her some time?
units.displayText: Should we give her some time?

spans.text: Should we give her some time?

units.rawText: Speaking of, it's been ages since we've seen Hubble asleep at a meeting. I reminisce...
units.displayText: Speaking of, it's been ages since we've seen Hubble asleep at a meeting. I reminisce...

spans.text: Speaking of, it's been ages since we've seen Hubble asleep at a meeting. I reminisce...

units.rawText: Ahh... mm. Reminisce...
units.displayText: Ahh... mm. Reminisce...

spans.text: Ahh... mm. Reminisce...

units.rawText: <size=28>Ah, she's awake...</size>
units.displayText: Ah, she's awake...

spans.text: Ah, she's awake...

units.rawText: Do you reminisce... of the past me?
units.displayText: Do you reminisce... of the past me?

spans.text: Do you reminisce... of the past me?

units.rawText: Were you not fully asleep? Or did we disturb you?
units.displayText: Were you not fully asleep? Or did we disturb you?

spans.text: Were you not fully asleep? Or did we disturb you?

units.rawText: I was asleep. I cannot say I was disturbed either... the border between stupor and lucidity was never well-defined.
units.displayText: I was asleep. I cannot say I was disturbed either... the border between stupor and lucidity was never well-defined.

spans.text: I was asleep. I cannot say I was disturbed either... the border between stupor and lucidity was never well-defined.

units.rawText: What was I like before? Did I enjoy sleep as much as I do now? I remember so very little.
units.displayText: What was I like before? Did I enjoy sleep as much as I do now? I remember so very little.

spans.text: What was I like before? Did I enjoy sleep as much as I do now? I remember so very little.

units.rawText: Not quite. It's more like... you had no love for dull things.
units.displayText: Not quite. It's more like... you had no love for dull things.

spans.text: Not quite. It's more like... you had no love for dull things.

units.rawText: That does sound similar... is that related to the "unchanging" part? I'm getting curious.
units.displayText: That does sound similar... is that related to the "unchanging" part? I'm getting curious.

spans.text: That does sound similar... is that related to the "unchanging" part? I'm getting curious.

units.rawText: Well, have you escaped from the topic of those plans and analyses?
units.displayText: Well, have you escaped from the topic of those plans and analyses?

spans.text: Well, have you escaped from the topic of those plans and analyses?

units.rawText: We have, yes, and are about to chase down scattered starlight. Interested?
units.displayText: We have, yes, and are about to chase down scattered starlight. Interested?

spans.text: We have, yes, and are about to chase down scattered starlight. Interested?

units.rawText: To... collect my data? Will you put me back together?
units.displayText: To... collect my data? Will you put me back together?

spans.text: To... collect my data? Will you put me back together?

units.rawText: You can understand it as such.
units.displayText: You can understand it as such.

spans.text: You can understand it as such.

units.rawText: Hehehe... of course. Seeing as this is your choice...
units.displayText: Hehehe... of course. Seeing as this is your choice...

spans.text: Hehehe... of course. Seeing as this is your choice...

units.rawText: Hubble picks up the miniature Entropic, giving it a rub, smiling with a lethargic demeanor. There almost seems to be more to her words, layers of ambiguity hiding roots and stems.
units.displayText: Hubble picks up the miniature Entropic, giving it a rub, smiling with a lethargic demeanor. There almost seems to be more to her words, layers of ambiguity hiding roots and stems.

spans.text: Hubble picks up the miniature Entropic, giving it a rub, smiling with a lethargic demeanor. There almost seems to be more to her words, layers of ambiguity hiding roots and stems.

units.rawText: Sounds interesting. Where will you decide to go, then?
units.displayText: Sounds interesting. Where will you decide to go, then?

spans.text: Sounds interesting. Where will you decide to go, then?

units.rawText: You choose, Hubble. These are your memories. Antonina's made the Search Terminal available, and we can use you as a reference point for any scattered data we pick up.
units.displayText: You choose, Hubble. These are your memories. Antonina's made the Search Terminal available, and we can use you as a reference point for any scattered data we pick up.

spans.text: You choose, Hubble. These are your memories. Antonina's made the Search Terminal available, and we can use you as a reference point for any scattered data we pick up.

units.rawText: No matter where we start, we'll end up trekking all over this Starsphere, because we still have Agents' data to retrieve.
units.displayText: No matter where we start, we'll end up trekking all over this Starsphere, because we still have Agents' data to retrieve.

spans.text: No matter where we start, we'll end up trekking all over this Starsphere, because we still have Agents' data to retrieve.

units.rawText: Then... let's just go to the closest place. Where'll it be, I wonder...
units.displayText: Then... let's just go to the closest place. Where'll it be, I wonder...

spans.text: Then... let's just go to the closest place. Where'll it be, I wonder...

units.rawText: Guard... guard...
units.displayText: Guard... guard...

spans.text: Guard... guard...

units.rawText: Guard... guard...
units.displayText: Guard... guard...

spans.text: Guard... guard...

units.rawText: Guard... space station...
units.displayText: Guard... space station...

spans.text: Guard... space station...

units.rawText: Then...
units.displayText: Then...

spans.text: Then...

units.rawText: As we navigate past a brown body sweeping with storms, a red planet wandering where no light thrives, and a blue world covered in roiling oceans, we reach our destination.
units.displayText: As we navigate past a brown body sweeping with storms, a red planet wandering where no light thrives, and a blue world covered in roiling oceans, we reach our destination.

spans.text: As we navigate past a brown body sweeping with storms, a red planet wandering where no light thrives, and a blue world covered in roiling oceans, we reach our destination.

units.rawText: An unimpressive thing lies before us. Remnant pieces of space station scrap are piled together in a disorderly heap, surrounded by a guard troop of Entropized Agents.
units.displayText: An unimpressive thing lies before us. Remnant pieces of space station scrap are piled together in a disorderly heap, surrounded by a guard troop of Entropized Agents.

spans.text: An unimpressive thing lies before us. Remnant pieces of space station scrap are piled together in a disorderly heap, surrounded by a guard troop of Entropized Agents.

units.rawText: Professor, we're here!
units.displayText: Professor, we're here!

spans.text: Professor, we're here!

units.rawText: We've never seen this one before... looks a little like a moon, but its orbit is somewhat strange.
units.displayText: We've never seen this one before... looks a little like a moon, but its orbit is somewhat strange.

spans.text: We've never seen this one before... looks a little like a moon, but its orbit is somewhat strange.

units.rawText: Let me see...
units.displayText: Let me see...

spans.text: Let me see...

units.rawText: It occupies and rotates on a very special orbit... appears as if it was placed here on purpose.
units.displayText: It occupies and rotates on a very special orbit... appears as if it was placed here on purpose.

spans.text: It occupies and rotates on a very special orbit... appears as if it was placed here on purpose.

units.rawText: If observed from a certain static angle, the observer can witness the full scope of lunar phase variations known to humanity within a short period, as well as various astronomical phenomena related to the moon.
units.displayText: If observed from a certain static angle, the observer can witness the full scope of lunar phase variations known to humanity within a short period, as well as various astronomical phenomena related to the moon.

spans.text: If observed from a certain static angle, the observer can witness the full scope of lunar phase variations known to humanity within a short period, as well as various astronomical phenomena related to the moon.

units.rawText: Probably something I made while I was dreaming... looks beautiful.
units.displayText: Probably something I made while I was dreaming... looks beautiful.

spans.text: Probably something I made while I was dreaming... looks beautiful.

units.rawText: Are my memories down there?
units.displayText: Are my memories down there?

spans.text: Are my memories down there?

units.rawText: It would appear so. Look, there's an icon on the Starsphere Monitoring Panel. I think it should be right in the middle, beneath that pile of electronic scrap...
units.displayText: It would appear so. Look, there's an icon on the Starsphere Monitoring Panel. I think it should be right in the middle, beneath that pile of electronic scrap...

spans.text: It would appear so. Look, there's an icon on the Starsphere Monitoring Panel. I think it should be right in the middle, beneath that pile of electronic scrap...

units.rawText: Shall we descend and have a look now? I think it should be this way...
units.displayText: Shall we descend and have a look now? I think it should be this way...

spans.text: Shall we descend and have a look now? I think it should be this way...

units.rawText: Hubble seizes Fresnel's hand, affably dragging her towards the cabin door via which she entered.
units.displayText: Hubble seizes Fresnel's hand, affably dragging her towards the cabin door via which she entered.

spans.text: Hubble seizes Fresnel's hand, affably dragging her towards the cabin door via which she entered.

units.rawText: W-Wait, Hubble! Let me put on PPE and...
units.displayText: W-Wait, Hubble! Let me put on PPE and...

spans.text: W-Wait, Hubble! Let me put on PPE and...

units.rawText: You mean those? There's no need.
units.displayText: You mean those? There's no need.

spans.text: You mean those? There's no need.

units.rawText: Hubble looks towards the spacesuits and helmets by the exit with confusion in her eyes, gesturing at the outside.
units.displayText: Hubble looks towards the spacesuits and helmets by the exit with confusion in her eyes, gesturing at the outside.

spans.text: Hubble looks towards the spacesuits and helmets by the exit with confusion in her eyes, gesturing at the outside.

units.rawText: There's no need for those hindrances in this dream.
units.displayText: There's no need for those hindrances in this dream.

spans.text: There's no need for those hindrances in this dream.

units.rawText: But only you can do that. I can't, Hubble. Give me a moment.
units.displayText: But only you can do that. I can't, Hubble. Give me a moment.

spans.text: But only you can do that. I can't, Hubble. Give me a moment.

units.rawText: You can, too.
units.displayText: You can, too.

spans.text: You can, too.

units.rawText: Uhh...
units.displayText: Uhh...

spans.text: Uhh...

units.rawText: You can move in space—without any of the protection?
units.displayText: You can move in space—without any of the protection?

spans.text: You can move in space—without any of the protection?

units.rawText: That's right. Just like you say, I'm an "Entropic". This is a dream of my very own.
units.displayText: That's right. Just like you say, I'm an "Entropic". This is a dream of my very own.

spans.text: That's right. Just like you say, I'm an "Entropic". This is a dream of my very own.

units.rawText: So long as I permit it, it shall come to pass.
units.displayText: So long as I permit it, it shall come to pass.

spans.text: So long as I permit it, it shall come to pass.

options.rawText: It's just part of the premise.
options.displayText: It's just part of the premise.

spans.text: It's just part of the premise.
Still feels strange...

units.rawText: Seeing as Jiutian's Entropics could pilot planets around as they desire and go where they please, it's little wonder this Starsphere has turned into what it is now...
units.displayText: Seeing as Jiutian's Entropics could pilot planets around as they desire and go where they please, it's little wonder this Starsphere has turned into what it is now...

spans.text: Seeing as Jiutian's Entropics could pilot planets around as they desire and go where they please, it's little wonder this Starsphere has turned into what it is now...

units.rawText: Even based on the presumption that we are accepting an Entropic's Weltanschauung, this is a little bit too outlandish to me.
units.displayText: Even based on the presumption that we are accepting an Entropic's Weltanschauung, this is a little bit too outlandish to me.

spans.text: Even based on the presumption that we are accepting an Entropic's Weltanschauung, this is a little bit too outlandish to me.

units.rawText: W-What about the Professor?
units.displayText: W-What about the Professor?

spans.text: W-What about the Professor?

units.rawText: If what you said is true, then maybe the Professor can also—
units.displayText: If what you said is true, then maybe the Professor can also—

spans.text: If what you said is true, then maybe the Professor can also—

units.rawText: Fresnel tugs at Hubble, and the two contemplate me for a moment.
units.displayText: Fresnel tugs at Hubble, and the two contemplate me for a moment.

spans.text: Fresnel tugs at Hubble, and the two contemplate me for a moment.

units.rawText: Hubble thinks for a moment, and soon nods. She is about to agree, but Antonina's voice on the other end of the call rings out, with a hint that her patience is at its end.
